floor.queue.title: Queue
floor.recognized: 🔔 You've been recognized: you have the floor.
floor.hint.request: Join the speaker queue. The chair will recognize you when it is your turn.
floor.hint.leave: Remove yourself from the speaker queue before you are called.
floor.hint.handle: Type the member handle you want to invite, for example alex (without the @).
floor.hint.invite_all: Invite this member to give a Right of Reply to the whole discussion.
floor.hint.next: Recognize the next queued speaker and give them the floor.
floor.hint.finish: End the current speaker turn so the next person can be called.
floor.hint.announcement_write: Write a short message that will be posted as an announcement.
floor.hint.announcement_send: Send this announcement to everyone on the general floor.
floor.hint.waiting: Show only members still waiting to speak.
floor.hint.done: Show completed or withdrawn speaker requests.
floor.hint.compact: Switch the queue table to a denser view.
floor.hint.more: Reveal more people in the speaker queue.
floor.hint.post: Publish your intervention to the discussion thread.
floor.hint.clear_reply: Remove the selected reply target and post as a general intervention.
floor.hint.ror: Ask to reply directly to this intervention. The chair will decide when to recognize you.
floor.hint.invite: Invite this member to give a Right of Reply to this intervention.
floor.hint.accept: Accept this Right of Reply invitation and enter the speaker queue.
floor.hint.decline: Decline this invitation. You will not be added to the queue.
floor.hint.close_list: Stop new speaker requests. Existing queued speakers stay in the queue.
floor.hint.open_list: Allow members to request the floor and join the speaker queue.
floor.composer_locked: The floor is reserved for the current speaker. You can request the floor above.
floor.chair.label: chairman
floor.ror.invited_all: Chair invited you to Right of Reply (to all)
floor.ror.invited_target: Chair invited you to Right of Reply on intervention #{target}
floor.error.not_speaking: You do not currently have the floor.
floor.error.closed: Speaker list is closed (use Right of Reply).
floor.error.toggle: Only president or chairman can toggle the floor
floor.error.call: Only president or chairman can call speakers
floor.error.finish: Only president or chairman can finish speakers
floor.error.take: Only the chair/president can take the floor
floor.error.invite: Only president or chairman can invite RoR
proposal_floor.none: No tabled drafts are currently available for discussion.
proposal_floor.view_draft_hint: Open the full tabled draft document in a separate page.
proposal_floor.invite_sponsors_hint: Ask the draft sponsors to introduce this proposal on the floor.
proposal_floor.announcement_hint: Send this announcement to everyone on the proposal floor.
proposal_floor.post_hint: Publish your intervention to the proposal floor discussion.
vote.consensus_help: Adopted by consensus if no “No” votes. (Abstentions not counted.)
vote.early_yes_hint: Vote Yes in the consensus check. If there are no No votes, the item may pass by consensus.
vote.early_no_hint: Vote No in the consensus check. A No vote prevents adoption by consensus.
vote.early_abstain_hint: Abstain from the consensus check. Abstentions are recorded but not counted as Yes or No.
vote.early_unopened: Early voting has not been opened yet.
vote.early_recorded: You have already cast your early vote.
vote.early_close_hint: Close the early consensus check and calculate whether consensus was reached.
vote.early_open_hint: Open the early consensus check so members can vote Yes, No, or Abstain.
proposal_floor.amendment_link_hint: Open this amendment's discussion and voting page.
vote.amendment_unopened: No vote has been opened for this amendment yet.
vote.majority_help: Simple majority of Yes vs No. Ties rejected. Abstentions are not counted.
vote.formal_yes_hint: Vote Yes in the formal vote. Formal voting uses Yes versus No majority.
vote.formal_no_hint: Vote No in the formal vote. If No votes are greater than or equal to Yes votes, the item is rejected.
vote.formal_abstain_hint: Abstain from the formal vote. Abstentions are recorded but not counted in Yes versus No.
vote.formal_recorded: You have already cast your formal vote.
vote.formal_unopened: Formal vote is not opened yet.
vote.formal_close_hint: Close the formal vote and calculate the final Yes versus No result.
vote.formal_open_hint: Open formal voting for this draft or amendment.
proposal_floor.close_discussion_hint: End the proposal floor discussion after voting has finished.
decision.none: No tabled draft resolutions or amendments for this event yet.
